M005.label: afflicted
M005.quote: The 5th house is spoilt and is a source of worry to the native. A male child was born on 15-10- 1898 and died within one month. Subsequently no otheir issues were born.

M013.label: afflicted
M013.quote: The conjunction of Saturn and Mars, the Moon and Ketu have spoiled the several good indications of the horoscope. The native is unimaginative, miserly, mean, undignified and over-cautious.
M013.note: Raman sums up character/temperament negatively after noting all three first-house factors are unfavourable; no explicit health verdict.

M021.label: afflicted
M021.quote: the fact of the ruler of the third becoming combust and hence powerless, renders the third house weak. This stands against his having any brothers.

M029.label: none
M029.note: Raman only records the marriage to Eleanor (1905) and its timing; he gives no judgment on the spouse or marital happiness.

M037.label: favourable
M037.quote: The native was a big industrialist and was one of the wealthiest Indians.
M037.note: Also 'Rahu is well placed in the 11th or house of gains' (line 12958).

M045.label: mixed
M045.quote: the position of Mars as a malefic lord creates tension and quarrels in married life, largely due to temperamental differences. But the position of Venus and the benefic disposition of Jupiter rule out any major trouble such as separation
M045.note: Well-placed partner and no separation, but quarrels and tension: explicitly two-sided.

M053.label: favourable
M053.quote: It is essentially these combinations that made Tagore what he was and that rendered his literary and intellectual achievements prodiguous.
M053.note: Nobel Prize in Moon Dasa Venus Bhukti also noted.

M061.label: afflicted
M061.quote: As a result, he lost his first wife and had to marry a second one.

M069.label: afflicted
M069.quote: Pitrukaraka Sun in the 9th is not Quite conducive to happy relations with father. Ford's father was not in sympathy with his bent towards mechanics.
M069.note: Chart 38 in NH is Henry Ford; the conclusion concerns the relationship with the father, not the father's life.

M077.label: afflicted
M077.quote: The native's wife has separated and he has no children horn to him.

M085.label: afflicted
M085.quote: the 5th house is spoiled with the result the Gaekwar was very unfortunate in regard to his children as most of them died during his life-time.

M093.label: favourable
M093.quote: The native has a happy married life. The aspect of 7th lord Jupiter on the 7th and of Karaka Venus also on it have given the native a devoted wife.

M101.label: favourable
M101.quote: This gives an exalted nature and a strong will, and renders the horoscope fortified.

M109.label: afflicted
M109.quote: made the native a revolutionary who was interned for political reasons. The conjunction of the 6th and the 12th lords Venus and Mars respectively are also responsible for the native's incarcerations.

M117.label: afflicted
M117.quote: The aspect of Mars on the 7th house occupied by Ketu has resulted in violent clashes in married life. The 7th house from Venus is occupied by a malefic Saturn depriving happiness in married life.
M117.note: Jupiter's aspect prevented a complete break-up, 'although life itself is miserable'.

M125.label: favourable
M125.quote: The disposition is generous. A good conversationalist with a fertile imagination and resourceful nature. The Moon is also free from afflictions. There is much pride in the mental disposition. The native is a businessman and is well off in life.

M133.label: mixed
M133.quote: explain the native's rise from humble life, his becoming a dictator, and his final violent end.
M133.note: Chart 204 (Mussolini): Saturn Dasa 'produced good results in the first half ... very unfavourable results' in the second; rise and fall both concluded.

M141.label: favourable
M141.quote: The native rose to eminence and wealth as a great industrialist from humble beginnings.

M149.label: mixed
M149.quote: Health will be fairly good but occasionally she will suffer from bodily complaints. She lacks self-confidence. She is nervous.
M149.note: Also 'during Jupiter's Dasha she suffered considerably from ill-health'.

M157.label: favourable
M157.quote: The horoscope is typical for longevity, temperate habits and intellectual attainments.

M165.label: favourable
M165.quote: the blemish-free 7th lords and 7th houses both from Lagna and the Moon have given a happy marriage.

M173.label: mixed
M173.quote: The native is not much educated in the sense of school-going, but she has the capacity of quick comprehension, is well informed and cultured.
M173.note: Formal schooling poor, informal learning good; explicitly two-sided.

M181.label: afflicted
M181.quote: totally blind in his 44th year. The 12th lord Venus is highly afflicted while lord of the 2nd, viz., Jupiter is in the 6th
M181.note: Raman treats total blindness; 'there was danger to his eyes through neglect'.

M189.label: afflicted
M189.quote: As Mars aspects the 8th and as Ayushkaraka is also in a Nigala Drekkana , the queen had to meet her end by being guillotined.

M197.label: favourable
M197.quote: This combination illustrates the fact that Marx was never in the habit of borrowing but of strongly asserting the results of his own research and of impressing upon other men.
M197.note: Conclusion drawn from exalted Venus in the 2nd (house of speech) and 2nd lord in own sign.

M205.label: afflicted
M205.quote: Severe afflictions to the Sun deprive one of father early in life. The ninth house and the ninth lord as well as pitrukaraka are quite heavily afflicted. The father died

M213.label: mixed
M213.quote: an unfortunate combination which involved him in trying lawsuits, brought against him by the authorities for his 'obscene writings'.
M213.note: No imprisonment: Raman notes proceedings were brought but 'Ellis himself was not molested' (line 7781); legal persecution suffered, incarceration not.

M221.label: afflicted
M221.quote: Throughout Saturn Dasha (for the first 12 years) the native suffered from liver and spleen troubles.
M221.note: Also spermatorrhoea and hydrocele in Mercury Dasha.

M229.label: none
M229.note: No business-partnership conclusion; on the 7th as marriage Raman says Mars and Rahu 'gave two marriages' and the first wife died (afflicted if the matter is read as marriage).

M237.label: favourable
M237.quote: The yoga gains some strength as a result of which the native is financially sound.

M245.label: afflicted
M245.quote: There are Bandhana Yogas also present. ... The native was in jail for over a year before he was hanged.

M253.label: favourable
M253.quote: During Jupiter Dasa the Swami's activities expanded on an international scale and his name became widely known. The Rajayoga part of Jupiter's power became completely manifest.
M253.note: Jupiter is the 9th lord (Dharma); fortune read through his Dasa and the yogas making him god-fearing and religious.

M261.label: favourable
M261.quote: Chart No. 126 is of an international figure in astrology whose predictions have been fulfilled to a remarkable degree.

M269.label: favourable
M269.quote: The 9th house from Karakamsa is occupied by a benefic and hence he was intent on doing virtuous actions ; always spoke the truth and respected parents and elders.

M277.label: afflicted
M277.quote: From Chandra Lagna, the 5th house and the 5th lord are subject to a number of afflictions. Consequently the native did not have any issue.

M285.label: none
M285.note: Raman draws no conclusion about Ashutosh Mukerjee's wealth; the 2nd house is discussed only for speech and orthodox habits.

M293.label: mixed
M293.quote: Such dispositions frequently result in great achievements but as Venus lord of the 6th and 11th also aspects the 9th, the life is often unhappy.
M293.note: About the 9th from Chandra Lagna; also 'confronted with obstacles and delay but ... the ultimate objects will be realised'.

M301.label: mixed
M301.quote: while the subject earns considerable money, the situation of Saturn and Rahu makes him spend his earnings on evil purposes. ... This indicates a checkered career and sudden rise and sudden fall.
M301.note: Wealth comes and is lost: he later 'lost all fortune and made a debt of Rs. 50,000'.

M309.label: afflicted
M309.quote: The native, an apostle of non-violence, was assassinated by a fanatic communalist.

M317.label: afflicted
M317.quote: This gave him a lot of opposition : Vivekananda's success, in his first address to the Parliament of Religions, roused bitter rancour
M317.note: Also 'Vivekananda was the buttend of considerable malevolent interpretations'.
